in another clinic they lost my time and also paid for it.  I quickly explained what I needed to do and they did it very quickly and efficiently.  I am very grateful to the girls for the efficiency and quality of work.  The staff is very pleasant.  Took a friend here too.  she was also pleased

text: I like that it was completed quickly. The staff were lovely and the doctor had a very gentle hand. The injection in my arm during COVID was more painful than the injection. ☺️

I had braces done here and everyone complimented my teeth. The dentist might not talk much, but they're very skilled. For my lower teeth, they gave me permanent braces, so I only needed to wear a retainer for my upper teeth. Life was so much easier!
Located in front of Suan Luang Park, this is a very classic-looking dental clinic. No upfront payment is required for social security beneficiaries. It meets international standards.
Good clinic, inexpensive treatment. I would recommend it.
The doctor and her assistant were lovely and very gentle. They were extremely attentive.

We were very lucky that the specialist was available and saw us right away, even though we were experiencing wisdom tooth pain. I don't know where else we could have gotten such quick help. The doctor speaks English and is very polite and attentive. She took an X-ray and immediately began extracting the tooth. I felt no pain, and the entire procedure took 30 minutes. There was a little soreness after the anesthesia wore off, but it was tolerable without medication. Thank you!

The doctor is beautiful, kind, gentle, and provides excellent service. I just had a molar extracted a few days ago. I'm usually afraid of needles and blood, but after seeing the doctor, my fear disappeared! Haha.

I went to get a dental bridge done. I have to say, the dentist was lovely, spoke kindly, and gave excellent advice. The assistants and receptionists were all very attentive and caring towards patients. For example, they called to confirm my appointment beforehand. Overall, everything was great. I highly recommend this dental clinic to anyone looking for one. ♥♥
A simple dental clinic with very good customer service. I had a tooth extracted here. I was nervous, but in the end I felt no pain at all. The extraction was quick. It only cost 900 baht.
